excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content:
<@735470118577897474> if you need to regenerate, just put

```python
    assert tx.payload.selector() == test.tx_payload_selector
    print(tx.encode_bytes().hex())     # <-- 
    assert tx.encode_bytes() == test.ssz_tx_bytes

    assert compute_sig_hash(tx) == test.sig_hash
    assert compute_tx_hash(tx) == test.rlp_tx_hash
    print(tx.hash_tree_root().hex())   # <-- 
    assert tx.hash_tree_root() == test.ssz_tx_root
```

the two prints here, into `convert_tests.py`, then copy paste the values into the test case and see whether it makes sense
